a: Thanks for all your hard work today!
You are very hard!
You worked bitter today!
qs.n: 英文沒有「辛苦了」的固定說法，要用感謝來表達：Thanks for all your hard work. 也可以說 Great job today!

qs.p: 「麻煩你了！」（請外師幫完忙之後）
a: Thanks so much, I really appreciate it!
Trouble you!
You are so troublesome!
qs.n: 「麻煩你了」的真正意思是感謝，英文直接說 I really appreciate it。troublesome 是「很煩人」。

qs.p: 「請你配合。」（請外師遵守新的簽到規定）
a: We'd really appreciate your help with this.
Please cooperate.
Please match with us.
qs.n: Please cooperate 在英文裡像警察對嫌犯說的話。換成 We'd appreciate your help / your support with this，對方會舒服很多。

a: Please bear with me. English isn't my first language.
My English is very poor, sorry sorry.
Please forgive my bad English, I am stupid.
qs.n: bear with me＝請包涵。說 English isn't my first language，不必自我貶低。其實妳的英文很好，這句可以少說！

qs.p: 「這是我的榮幸。」（外師謝謝妳幫忙）
a: It's my pleasure!
This is my honor.
This is my glory.
qs.n: 別人道謝時回 My pleasure / Happy to help 最自然。It's an honor 用在很正式的場合，例如受邀致詞。

a: You've got this!
Add oil!
Add gasoline!
qs.n: You've got this! / Good luck tomorrow! 都很好。Add oil 有些外國人知道是中式英文的梗，但不是正式用法。

a: I'm heading out. See you tomorrow!
I go first!
I walk first!
qs.n: I'm heading out / I'm off 是道地的「我先走了」。

a: Your Chinese has really improved!
Your Chinese is very progress!
Your Chinese has progressed a lot of.
qs.n: 「進步」用動詞 improve。progress 多半當名詞：You've made a lot of progress.

qs.p: 「原則上不行，但我幫你問問看。」
a: Generally that's not allowed, but let me check for you.
In principle no can, but I help you ask.
Principle is not okay, but I ask ask.
qs.n: 「原則上」常用 generally / as a rule。in principle 在英文常常帶「理論上可以」的意思，反而容易誤會。

a: Let me check and get back to you.
I confirm then reply you.
I will again confirm with you after.
qs.n: get back to you＝之後回覆你，是職場超高頻用語。

qs.p: 「有沒有問題？」（會議結束前問大家）
a: Does anyone have any questions?
Is there a problem?
Have problem or not?
qs.n: Is there a problem? 聽起來像要吵架（「你有意見嗎？」）。會議尾聲問 Any questions? 就好。

a: The meeting has been moved to three o'clock.
Meeting time changes to three.
The meeting time is changed at three.
qs.n: 改時間用 move / reschedule；改到「某時」用 to。

a: Let's find another time that works.
We again make an appointment time.
We will date again.
qs.n: date 是「約會」，千萬小心！說 find another time / reschedule。

a: Please email the files to me.
Please send the data to my mailbox.
Please mail the information to my letter box.
qs.n: 「信箱」就說 email，email 本身就能當動詞。mailbox 是門口的實體信箱；「資料」通常是 files / documents，不一定是 data。

a: She's not at her desk right now.
She is not on her seat now.
She doesn't exist now.
qs.n: 「在位子上」是 at one's desk。on her seat 聽起來像坐在椅子上面。

a: Could you hold on a moment, please?
Please wait a little.
Please slowly wait.
qs.n: 電話用語：hold on / one moment, please。

qs.p: 「這個月的薪水已經匯進去了。」
a: This month's pay has been deposited into your account.
This month salary already remit in.
This month money already went inside.
qs.n: 薪水「匯入」用 deposited into your account；口語說 Your pay just went in. 也可以。

a: I'll do my best.
I will try my most.
I will as much as possible.
qs.n: 「盡量」= I'll do my best / I'll try my best。

a: Hey, how's it going?
Have you eaten full?
Did you eat already or not?
qs.n: 台灣的「吃飽沒」其實是打招呼。英文對應是 How's it going? / How are you doing?

a: Sorry, I'm not sure I follow.
I listen not understand your meaning.
I can't hear your meaning.
qs.n: I'm not sure I follow＝我好像沒跟上你的意思，很禮貌。也可以說 What do you mean by…?

a: Sorry, could you say that again?
Can again say one time?
Please repeat again one more time.
qs.n: repeat again 重複了。說 Could you say that again? / Sorry, come again? 都很自然。

a: Our students tend to be on the shy side.
Our school's students are compare shy.
Our students are more shy than other students.
qs.n: 中文的「比較」常只是語氣詞，不是真的在比較。英文用 tend to be / a bit / on the shy side。

a: Our school places a lot of emphasis on English.
Our school very values English.
Our school sees English very heavy.
qs.n: 「重視」：place emphasis on / take English very seriously。very 不能直接修飾動詞。

a: Our school is in a rural area.
Our school is in the countryside down.
Our school is at the village bottom.
qs.n: rural area＝鄉下地區。也可以說 out in the countryside。

a: Is there anything I can help you with?
Please ask what do you need help?
What help do you need, please ask?
qs.n: 「請問」不是 please ask。英文用疑問句本身就有「請問」的禮貌。

qs.p: 「你可以先離開了。」（會後，事情已經處理完）
a: You're free to go now. Thanks!
You can leave first.
You can go away now.
qs.n: go away 是「走開」，很不禮貌！說 You're free to go / That's all for today。

a: I need to make copies of this handout.
I need to print copy this information.
I need to Xerox this data.
qs.n: 影印＝make copies / photocopy。「講義」是 handout。

a: Let's meet in the office after school.
After school we gather together in the office.
Put school after, office collect.
qs.n: 「集合」日常就說 meet；gather 也對，但聽起來很正式。
